name: usage-limits
description: Shows the 5-hour and weekly usage limits as a band above the prompt, with a pace verdict and the session's tokens.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the band, the commands, the messages and this menu.

windows.title: Windows shown
windows.description: Which limits the band shows: both, five_hour or seven_day.

warnAt.title: Alert threshold (%)
warnAt.description: The bar turns red and a toast shows from this usage.

cautionAt.title: Caution threshold (%)
cautionAt.description: The bar turns orange from this usage.

paceMargin.title: Neutral zone (points)
paceMargin.description: Gap between usage and elapsed time under which the pace stays normal.

showDelta.title: Show the gap in points
showDelta.description: Writes the pace gap beside each bar, like +12.

showPaceMark.title: Show the time mark
showPaceMark.description: Draws the tick on each bar where the clock stands in the window. Off: the bar shows only the usage.

showForecast.title: Forecast the limit
showForecast.description: Writes when the limit will be reached at this pace, if that comes before the reset.

resetFormat.title: Reset format
resetFormat.description: duration writes the time left; clock writes the time of the reset.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: auto adapts to the width; wide, medium or narrow forces one.

barHeight.title: Bar thickness (px)
barHeight.description: Thickness of each usage bar, in pixels. The terminal draws its bars in text and ignores it.

bandPadding.title: Band height (rows)
bandPadding.description: Vertical space above and below the band's content, in rows. 0 makes the band as low as it gets.

showTokens.title: Show the tokens
showTokens.description: Writes under the band the last turn's input and output tokens, the session's totals and the context fill.

isCompact.title: Compact style
isCompact.description: Drops the bar: only the label and the percentage.

history.title: History pane
history.description: Records each limit's daily peak and the tokens, and opens the pane at each session.
